Legal & privacy hub

Policy documents are prepared for review. Company identity, monitored contacts, governing jurisdiction and final policy decisions are still required before contract activation. Updated October 7, 2026.

Know who does what

Mow Matter supplies software. Independent lawn-care operators perform lawn services. A request is not a booking, and a software subscription is separate from a homeowner’s lawn-care payment.

Your choices

Read the Privacy Policy for customer records, crew location and job photos. Use privacy controls to change optional measurement on this browser. Use the request form for privacy, marketing opt-out, accessibility or support inquiries.

Agreements and payments

The Terms explain account use, tier fees, operator responsibilities and limitations. Homeowner request information explains how inquiries become an approved quote and confirmed service. Billing disclosures distinguish subscriptions, operator fees and Stripe processing.

Marketing and availability

Sponsored listings are paid placements. Demonstrations use sample data. Growth and valuation scenarios are estimates, not guaranteed revenue, sale value, financing or route savings. Features described as planned are not available promises.
